from store import Store
from setup import begin_setup, complete_setup, active_connection
from cleanup import cleanup_setup
# Scenario: cleanup a cancelled/superseded setup must not evict the live one
s = Store()
begin_setup(s,"w","one"); complete_setup(s,"w","one","conn1")   # active=one
begin_setup(s,"w","two")                                         # two pending (never completed)
cleanup_setup(s,"w","two")                                       # cancel pending two
print("active after cleaning up unrelated pending setup:", active_connection(s,"w"))
'
